Class ResourceManager

java.lang.Object
me.leoko.advancedgui.manager.ResourceManager
public class ResourceManager extends Object
The ResourceManager manages images and fonts used by GUI components.

    • getImage

      public BufferedImage getImage(String name, int width, int height, boolean dithering, int intensity)
      Gets an image by name resized to the provided size and applied dithering if requested.
      Parameters:
      name - the name
      width - the width
      height - the height
      dithering - whether to apply dithering
      intensity - the dithering intensity in percent (0–100); only used when dithering is true
      Returns:
      the buffered image

    • processImage

      public BufferedImage processImage(BufferedImage image, int width, int height, boolean dithering, int intensity)
      Process an image without registering it to the ResourceManager. Will be resized and optionally applying dithering.
      Parameters:
      image - the image
      width - the new width
      height - the new height
      dithering - whether to apply dithering
      intensity - the dithering intensity in percent (0–100); only used when dithering is true
      Returns:
      the result buffered image

    • clear

      public void clear()
      Clears all resource caches and restores the built-in default fonts. Custom resources are re-registered from the layout files on the following reload.
